testcase.name: Scenario: Retain display options when re-adding a staged command: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1450:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain display options when re-adding a staged command ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And ribbon customization shows All Commands and an initially empty Part Tools target ✔ And 2D Sketches has been staged in the target list ✔ And its Large and Text options are checked ✔ When the user selects the 2D Sketches target row and clicks the remove command button ✔ Then the target list is empty ✔ And 2D Sketches is highlighted in the available commands list ✔ And the target shows a pending-change marker ✔ When the user clicks the add command button ✔ Then 2D Sketches appears in the target list ✔ And its Large and Text options are checked ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And the Tools ribbon remains visible
